resultados.explicacion: Se ha lesionado means she has injured herself, so the knee was hurt.
Se disfrazó de means he dressed up as, using a costume.
Aprobó a la primera means he passed on the first attempt, with no miracle involved.
El sol se pone means the sun goes down, so it sets.
Desemboca en means a river flows out into the sea, here the Atlantic.
Quien siembra vientos recoge tempestades is a proverb: you get back what you do.
Un dormilón is someone who sleeps a lot, a sleepyhead.
Embarazada means pregnant, not embarrassed, which is the false friend.
Actualmente means currently, not actually, which is the false friend.
No pretendo means I don't intend or mean to, not that I pretend.
Estoy hecho polvo means I'm exhausted, literally made into dust.
Manejar means to drive, the usual verb in Latin America.
Sube el paro means unemployment rises, and por tercer mes gives the period.
Se desconocen las causas means the causes are unknown, using the se passive.
Por pequeña que sea means however small it may be, a concessive construction.
Sin haber podido volver means without having been able to return.
No sé cómo se llama means I don't know what her name is.
No lo use is the formal negative command, meaning do not use it.
El ayuntamiento explica que means the town council says or explains that.
Al principio means at first, and sin embargo means however or nevertheless.
En caso de que falte means if a document is missing, then they will contact you.
Mientras tanto means meanwhile, linking the sentence to the time.
A pesar de means despite, and merece la visita means it is worth visiting.
